name: blender_apply
description:
Change the scene with up to 50 typed operations as ONE undo step. Everything is checked first (names, bones, aliases, expect, if_revision); a failure while applying restores what the batch changed. Result: what changed (before/after), created names, new revision. Without if_revision the batch applies to the document as it is now.
Each operation is {op: '<name>', ...its fields}. Refs are object names; an object created or copied earlier in the batch is "$alias" (its "as"); a rename or delete is visible to the later operations. Colours are linear RGB.
Shapes: rotation {euler_deg:[x,y,z], order?=XYZ} or {quaternion:[w,x,y,z]}, in the holder's own rotation mode; target {point:[x,y,z]} | {object, bone?} | {direction:[x,y,z]}; goal {point:[x,y,z]} | {object, bone?}, with rotation? (the end bone's world orientation); paths [location|rotation|scale]; path an RNA path such as constraints["Grab"].influence or key_blocks["Blink"].value; frames [first, last]; nodes [{name, type? (a new node: ShaderNodeTexNoise, ShaderNodeValToRGB, ShaderNodeMix...), location?:[x,y], label?, inputs?:{socket: value}, props?:{attribute: value}, ramp?:[[position, [r,g,b,a]], ...]}]; links [{from:[node, output], to:[node, input]}].
set_transform {ref, location?, rotation?, scale?, delta?=false}: Location, rotation (written in the object's own rotation mode) and scale; delta adds the location. Rule: give location, rotation or scale.
fit_height {ref, height?, ground?=true, ground_z?=0.0, children?=true, scale_axes?:z|uniform=z, frame?, key?=false}: Scale to a height in metres (Z only by default; scale_axes uniform keeps the proportions) and/or put the lowest point at ground_z, measured on the evaluated geometry (armature pose and modifiers included) at frame (default: the current frame, which stays current); key keys the location (and scale) there, so a falling body touches the ground at each of its key frames. Without height nothing is scaled. Rule: give height or ground true. Rule: height above 0.
pose_bone {ref, bone, location?, rotation?, scale?}: A pose bone's location, rotation (in the bone's rotation mode) and scale. Rule: give location, rotation or scale.
aim_bone {ref, bone, target, axis?:Y|-Y|X|-X|Z|-Z=Y, tolerance_deg?}: Rotate a pose bone about its head so its axis points at a point, an object (or one of its bones) or along a world direction; reports error_deg and refuses a miss above tolerance_deg.
reach {ref, chain, target, pole?, frame?, key?, tolerance?}: Two-bone IK solved once and written as a pose: chain is [upper, lower] or [upper, lower, end] (an arm, and its hand), each the parent of the next. The lower bone's tail reaches target (a point, an object or one of its bones), the elbow bends toward pole (a point, an object, a bone or a world direction; default: the side it bends to now), and end takes the target's world orientation (an object or bone target, or target.rotation). At frame (which stays current) it keys the chain's rotations (key, default true with frame). Reports error (metres), end_error_deg and the elbow; refuses a miss above tolerance (default 1 mm), such as a target out of reach. Rule: each bone of chain is the parent of the next. Rule: target is point or object (with bone), rotation optional. Rule: key needs frame.
insert_key {ref, bone?, paths?, path?, index?, owner?:object|data|shape_keys=object, value?, frame, interpolation?:CONSTANT|LINEAR|BEZIER}: Key at a frame the current location, rotation and/or scale (paths) of an object or pose bone, or any animatable property by its RNA path (path), such as constraints["Grab"].influence, key_blocks["Blink"].value with owner shape_keys, lens with owner data, or ["prop"]; with bone the path is the pose bone's. value sets the property first; index keys one element of an array. Rule: give paths or path (one of them). Rule: value and index go with path. Rule: owner other than object goes with path, without bone.
delete_keys {ref, bone?, paths?, path?, index?, owner?:object|data|shape_keys=object, frames?}: Delete the keys of paths (location, rotation, scale) or of one RNA path (each array element unless index) in frames [first, last] (all without frames); an F-curve left without keys is removed. Rule: give paths or path (one of them). Rule: index goes with path. Rule: owner other than object goes with path, without bone. Rule: frames is [first, last] with first at most last.
create_object {kind:empty|camera|light|mesh|text, name, as?, primitive?:cube|plane|uv_sphere|cylinder|cone, size?, depth?, light_type?:POINT|SUN|SPOT|AREA, energy?, lens?, body?, extrude?, align_x?:LEFT|CENTER|RIGHT|JUSTIFY|FLUSH, align_y?:TOP|TOP_BASELINE|CENTER|BOTTOM_BASELINE|BOTTOM, location?, rotation?, collection?, parent?}: A new empty, camera, light, mesh primitive or text; as names it $alias for later operations. Mesh size (default 1 m): a cube's edge, a plane's side, a uv_sphere's diameter, a cylinder's diameter and height, a cone's base diameter and height; depth sets a cylinder's or cone's height apart (a barrel 0.6 wide and 0.9 high: size 0.6, depth 0.9). Text: body, size (font size in metres, default 1), extrude (depth), align_x, align_y. Rule: primitive and size apply to a mesh; depth to a cylinder or cone; light_type and energy to a light; lens to a camera; body, size, extrude, align_x and align_y to a text. Rule: a text needs body.
rename {ref, name}: Rename an object.
delete {refs?, collections?}: Delete objects (refs) and empty collections (collections): their names are free for the batch's later operations at once (and an object's data's when only it used it); they leave the document when the batch succeeds. Rule: give refs or collections. Rule: a collection is deleted empty: its objects and child collections are deleted by the same batch or moved first.
duplicate {ref, as?, name?, suffix?, offset?, linked?=false, children?=true}: Copy an object with its whole hierarchy (children false: alone) into the same collections, moved by offset in world space. linked shares the data (Blender's Alt+D), otherwise each copy gets its own (Shift+D); materials and actions stay shared. name names the copy of ref, suffix is added to every copy's original name (Blender's .001 otherwise); as names the copy of ref $alias. Rule: name, suffix and as apply to the copy of ref (suffix to every copy).
set_material {ref, material, color?, roughness?, metallic?, slot?}: Assign a material to an object's slot, creating it (Principled BSDF) when no material has that name; color (linear RGB, also the viewport colour), roughness and metallic set its Principled BSDF, also on an existing material. Without slot: its only slot (added when it has none); slot equal to the number of slots adds one. Rule: color, roughness and metallic are optional: without them an existing material is only assigned.
material_nodes {material, nodes?, links?, ref?, slot?}: Build or edit a material's shader graph: nodes adds a node per entry ({name, type, location, label, inputs: {socket: value}, props: {attribute: value}, ramp: [[position, [r, g, b, a]], ...]}) or updates the node of that name (Principled BSDF and Material Output in a new material); links connects {from: [node, output], to: [node, input]}, replacing what fed that input. Procedural textures (ShaderNodeTexNoise, TexVoronoi, TexWave...), mixes, color ramps and bumps included. A material of that name is made when there is none; ref assigns it like set_material. Rule: give nodes, links or ref. Rule: a new node needs type. Rule: slot goes with ref.
scene_settings {frame_start?, frame_end?, frame_current?, fps?}: The scene's frame range, current frame (animation evaluated there) and frames per second (a fractional rate such as 23.976 sets fps and fps_base). Rule: give at least one field. Rule: frame_start at most frame_end when both are given; one alone may not cross the scene's other end (refused, never pushed).
shift_keys {ref, bone?, paths?, frames?, offset?, delete?=false}: Move the keys of an object (or one pose bone) in frames [first, last] (all without frames) by offset frames, handles included, or delete them; paths narrows them to location, rotation and/or scale. The keys of its action's slot (Blender 5 layered actions). Rule: give offset (not 0) or delete true, not both. Rule: frames is [first, last] with first at most last. Rule: a key may not land on a key that does not move (refused).
link {ref, collection}: Link an object into a collection.
unlink {ref, collection}: Unlink an object from a collection (never from its last one: use delete).
create_collection {name, parent?}: A new collection, in parent or the scene's.
set_parent {ref, parent?, bone?, keep_transform?=true}: Parent an object (to a bone with bone), or clear its parent without parent; keeps its world transform. Rule: bone needs parent.
add_marker {name, frame, camera?}: A timeline marker, optionally bound to a camera.
set_camera {ref}: Make a camera the scene's active camera.
add_constraint {ref, type:TRACK_TO|DAMPED_TRACK|COPY_LOCATION|COPY_ROTATION|COPY_TRANSFORMS|CHILD_OF, target, subtarget?, name?, influence?}: An object constraint targeting an object (subtarget: one of its bones), with its influence (0 to 1). Rule: influence from 0 to 1.
switch_parent {ref, parent?, bone?, frame}: From frame on, the object follows parent (one of its bones with bone; the world without parent) without a jump: an anchor empty is made under parent where the object is at that frame, and a Copy Transforms constraint to it takes over at that frame (influences keyed CONSTANT: this switch's 1, earlier switches' 0). Before frame nothing changes. A revolver goes holster, hand, ground in three operations. Rule: bone needs parent. Rule: parent is not the object or one of its children.

if_revision.description: Revision from blender_context; refused if the scene changed since.

command_id.description: Unique ID; replaying it applies nothing and returns the first result.
